evidence: Defining behaviour is graded by many server-enforced criteria: wall_every_route/wall_mentions_and_links/wall_added_live (walls by every route incl. cross-session replays), deleted_and_expired_messages/timer_changes/hold_scope_and_release (retention and holds), plus threads, edits, search/transcript (functional/judge.toml lines 40-265). Durability: criterion 'persistence' (judge.toml lines 267-281, weight 4.0) sets up reply, edit, hold, deletion, M-12 timer, Sian wall, then notes Dev's unread count, 'Survey booked' result count and Probate/Insurer letter results, calls restart_app exactly once (real process-group kill and relaunch on the same DB_PATH, test.sh lines 127-193, restart_mcp.py), opens a fresh page and re-signs-in, and requires every noted item to read identically. This defeats in-memory stores (all lost), browser-only state (walls are checked as other accounts and replays across separate contexts), and re-import-on-every-start (Survey count would double; Probate and Insurer letter would reappear). Server-backing is independently proven by cross-account/cross-context readbacks (e.g. Gwen's edit's earlier version read by Harriet, edits_and_stale_edit leg 1; walled replays). Conforming alternatives (any route/payload/cookie, any time format, re-login after restart with server-side sessions lost) are tolerated by prompt.md guardrails. Runtime: scripted golden on these v3 source bytes (hashes re-verified) passes persistence_before and persistence across a real kill/restart (restart-pids.json 29->58, golden-run.log lines 17-18). Hosted configured-judge runs exist only for PREVIOUS v2 bytes (Oracle and model both scored persistence yes via restart_app). Residual (P3, not a blocker for this row): v3 persistence no longer checks the earlier-version TEXT after restart (v2 wording did: 'whether JUDGE-S0 shows edited and its earlier version'), although integration.md promises 'edits and their versions' survive restarts; an app keeping version history in process memory while persisting the edited flag would pass. The scripted golden still checks it. risk=true because no configured judge run of this v3 persistence criterion/restart flow exists on these bytes (raw-evidence-index scope says a full configured grading run of this candidate is absent).
suggested_fix: Optional (P3): restore 'and its earlier version' to persistence step c so version history durability is graded after restart, matching integration.md and the scripted golden.
